item.title: Foo Fighters’ Pat Smear Breaks Foot In Gardening Accident, Will Not Perform On Throne
item.description: A little over a decade ago, Dave Grohl broke his leg onstage in Sweden, prompting the Foo Fighters to cancel a bunch of tour dates before the frontman eventually returned to perform in an ergonomic motorized throne. Now, unfortunately, his bandmate Pat Smear has succumbed to a similar fate, having recently "smashed the shit out of his left foot" during a "bizarre gardening accident." item.title: Geese Making Inevitable SNL Debut This Month
item.description: Geese are playing Saturday Night Live. It's to be expected, given that Cameron Winter and friends — makers of Getting Killed, our pick for the best album of 2025 — have been anointed as an Important New York City Rock Band and are being embraced as such by all the old-guard local institutions. item.description: Bruno Mars' most recent solo album 24K Magic came out nearly 10 years ago. Ten!
